assumptions.assumption: A drop of >=25% in both BGP visibility and active-probing responsiveness reflects a real loss of end-user connectivity rather than a single route-collector disconnect.
assumptions.test: Require corroboration across at least two independent signal families (IODA BGP + active probing, or IODA + OONI) before raising confidence above Low.

assumptions.assumption: Concurrent BGP/probing drops in multiple countries sharing a submarine cable landing corridor indicate a shared physical transport or transit fault rather than independent domestic shutdowns.
assumptions.test: Check whether OONI censorship anomalies spiked before the drop (indicating domestic policy) and check cross-program tips from Elements (earthquakes) and Wake (AIS loitering).

assumptions.assumption: OONI probe sample counts (>=50/day) in monitored countries are sufficient to distinguish nationwide DPI blocking from transient local network errors.
assumptions.test: During total BGP blackouts, OONI probes cannot upload reports until connectivity returns; treat zero OONI uploads during a BGP drop as corroboration of total blackout, not absence of censorship.
